MR Safety
The Fjord Stent is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 T or 3 T
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 3 T/m
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 200 T/m/s per axis
B1+rms not specified ≤ 1.2 μT
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg ≤ 0.4 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 1 W/kg not specified
Maximum active scan time 60 minutes 30 minutes
At 3T, the whole-body SAR limit applies only to MR scanners that do not report B1+rms.
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 2 mm beyond the implant.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
